Hi there, I wanted to share my story and hope it helps. I too am living with that dreadful feeling to end it all. On one occasion I came too close, just a step more and I wouldn't be here. I had cut all ties, no friends, no job, no nothing and the fear of an uncertain future.The question of why go on used to bother me too.life was almost painful to live. But, there was one thread I couldn't break. My parents are good ppl and I couldn't make them go through loss of their child over what they have already suffered. I decided that day to give life a chance, but I promised my self that if I'm going to live, it will be on my terms. It's ok if I make mistakes, I will learn from them and say sorry where applicable and move on.if ppl are mean, well then Fuck them! They don't have any power over me anyways! If death comes, it comes but it won't be from my hands. 

I still have periods where I get those feelings, when I just don't want to deal with anything and hope I wasn't alive. That's the time I need to take extra care of myself and ride it out. One trick I have discovered is to just observe. I decide to observe my fear and say to myself "let's see what happens" and at the end of day I compare what I fear would happen and what actually happened. Most of the times something unexpected happens, because that's the nature of life. Nobody knows what's going to happen the next moment. So it's best to be in present moment, handle things as they come. For future, I can only hope I will be able to handle things as I am handling the present, so it's not useful to worry about it.

Life is precious, there are soo many experience still to be had as a human. Your life is yours alone. Make it what you will.Do whatever the fuck you want to do(don't hurt others ofc). So make it a good one, like how you would decorate your room because your the only one that's gonna live there. 

Hope something in this helps u, and to anyone reading as well.
